description_en: Retrieves the configurable fields and operators for automated rule policies
description_zh: 获取自动化规则策略可配置字段及操作符
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem describe-automate-response-config-feature --auto-response-type event --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutomateResponseConfigFeature

parameters.help_en:
The automated response type. Valid values:
event: Event.
alert: Alert
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应类型。取值：
event：事件
alert：告警
parameters.name: auto_response_type

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:
0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located in regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
